promises.label: Thermal power capacity expansion to 5.5-6 GW
promises.quote: we had given a commitment to the Ministry that we will enhance our capacity to almost 5.5- 6.0 gigawatts. We are looking at even further expanding this in the next 6 to 9 months' time.
promises.speaker: Subramanian Sarma

promises.label: 10-15 GW incremental thermal orders
promises.quote: we are gearing up for taking up additional maybe 10, 15 gigawatts in the next 2, 3 years.
promises.speaker: Subramanian Sarma

promises.label: AMCA prototype winner Q4 next FY
promises.quote: the announcement of the winner to build the prototype most likely is going to happen Q4 of the next financial year
promises.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

promises.label: AMCA shortlist expected Oct-Dec 2025
promises.quote: This shortlist is expected in the current quarter, October to December '25.
promises.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

promises.label: Hyderabad Metro exit by end FY26
